title: Dandelion OS v4.2.0: Zero-Copy DMA-BUF and io_uring Substrate Pipeline
description: Dandelion OS v4.2.0 release introducing a high-performance, zero-allocation C99/Rust-compatible DMA-BUF and io_uring zero-copy pipeline with 64-byte L1 cache-line alignment, strict static assertions, and automated triad verification.
